## Checklist

- [ ] The list is curated, with a description for each item, not just links
- [ ] It is public on GitHub, not archived, and pushed to in the last 18 months
- [ ] It has 500 or more stars, or it is the best list in a small niche (never under 25)
- [ ] It is not already listed, and it adds something the neighbouring entries do not
- [ ] I put it in the right section and kept the section in alphabetical order
- [ ] My entry follows `- [name](url) by Owner - Short description.` and ends with a full stop
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes
